messages:
lina: quickstop — noticed two small but confusing auth issues in the hello-web quickstart. the tutorial shows exporting REDWOOD_API_KEY but the starter app expects REDWOOD_KEY. also the env-vars section link goes to an older doc. opening a PR with fixes and tests. cc @sam @jon :eyes:

sam: thanks! can you paste the exact snippet you changed so i can update the node example too? :+1:

lina: sure — current tutorial has this (incorrect):

```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-…
# run: npm start
```

changed in PR to this canonical form and added an explanation about local .env vs CI:

```bash
# set locally (mac/linux)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
# if starter app reads REDWOOD_KEY, we recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY for consistency
# add to .env for docker: REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
```

jon: small note — the Node SDK snippet in the quickstart still uses the old header example. suggestion: show both curl and SDK minimal usage so folks understand header → SDK mapping. e.g. quick curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate`

niya: can we also add a short section about token rotation (link to secrets KMS page) and an explicit callout for env var name mismatch? customers keep hitting this when they copy-paste. maybe a single-sentence warning block with :warning:

lina: yep — added a "migration note" in the PR for both starter apps (node & python) and a warning callout. also fixed the broken env-vars anchor link (was pointing to /docs/old-envs). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — tests added to smoke-run the starter app in CI.

sam: nice. i pulled the branch locally, ran the quickstart container, and verified the example env file works. one nit: update the SDK4→SDK5 migration snippet — some teams are still on older clients.

lina: added SDK migration blurb (how to change header usage and example imports). kept it short: two lines and a link to the full migration guide.

pr-bot: PR #412 opened by lina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — status: open, tests: running (smoke, linkcheck).

jon: after tests pass, can we also get a tiny UX tweak — move the env var note above the first deploy step so it's visible before people deploy with the wrong key. :eyes:

lina: done in branch — note now sits in the Getting Started -> Configure creds section. i'll merge on green and file a follow-up to update the Quickstart checklist doc. thanks all. :tada:
